newsitem.title: BRAZIL: At least four killed in Brazil jailbreak attempt.
newsitem.headline: At least four killed in Brazil jailbreak attempt.

text.p: At least four people were killed on Wednesday when inmates hijacked a garbage truck and tried to plough through the gates of Latin America's largest prison, news reports said.

At least three of the five inmates driving the truck were shot to death by guards at Carandiru prison in downtown Sao Paulo, CBN Radio reported. It said a passerby outside the prison gate was hit by the truck and killed. Television earlier said a guard died after being struck by the truck.

Another group of prisoners reportedly took up to 27 hostages and demanded a cellular telephone and the transfer of seven prisoners to another penitentiary, CBN said. A prison spokesman said he was unable to confirm exactly what happened because the situation was still chaotic.
With some 6,300 inmates and more than 1,000 guards and administrative staff, Carandiru is Latin America's largest prison complex. In May, 53 inmates escaped after digging a tunnel under prison walls.
Carandiru was also the site of Brazil's most violent prison riot in October 1992, when 111 inmates were shot to death by military police.
